name: Corewell Health/William Beaumont University (Dearborn/Royal Oak) Program

gap_details.2011-2012..2013-2014: Before the earliest cohort (Elfallal, entry 2014). The 2019 program page calls it a 'newly accredited 7-year program ... 1 resident/year'. Not counted as missing.
gap_details.2014-2015..2016-2017: Phase 2: reconstructed with Elfallal only. He was a resident of the Beaumont Hospital System osteopathic neurosurgery program at Trenton (ex-Oakwood Southshore; the 'Dearborn' of the program name), which fed into the ACGME program: 'Beaumont Hospital System, Neurological surgery, PGY4 resident, Trenton, MI' (Spartan Med Res J Apr 2018, PMID 33655134; co-author Samer Elfallal, Chief of Neurosurgery Trenton). NPI enumerated 2014-06-26. No web roster exists for the precursor.

departures.name: Layla Nachar
departures.note: Entered 2020 (LSU New Orleans MD). Gone by Jan 2023; not on graduates page. joiners.name: Wissam Elfallal
joiners.note: Not an outside transfer: in the Beaumont Trenton osteopathic neurosurgery residency since 2014 (PGY4 Apr 2018, PMID 33655134), carried into the ACGME program. Graduated 2021; now AdventHealth Daytona Beach.

joiners.name: Casey Spinelli
joiners.note: Transfer in at PGY2 (listed PGY1 in Jan 2023, PGY3 2023-24). 2021-22 in New Orleans with 'Tulane University & Ochsner Clinic Neurosurgery Program' affiliation (PMIDs 34718197, 35599459) but absent from the Tulane categorical roster (Jan 2022): probably a prelim/research PGY1, not a Tulane departure. Took the place vacated by Nachar.
